entries.descriptionOriginal: Igreja Halloween | 5 Arenas 1v1 | Rekting.pt Five matching church arenas for 1v1 duels. With ten active players all five arenas host a duel. Complete visual revision Smooth rounded pillars, arches, altar edges and ornaments; opaque carved oak pews; embedded doors and structural collision fixes; aligned lantern candles; matching blue stained glass with grey bars and aligned sills; improved spawn lighting; English skin instructions; dark three-dimensional relief sculptures. Native lighting and reflections rebuilt at high quality for all five arenas. On the Rekting Arena server One seated damageable witch per arena, disappearing with smoke and returning on the next duel. Two articulated white skeletons on the two large central chandeliers. One pumpkin HE grenade per duelist, with native grenade damage and physics and the old pin removed. Global duel rounds wait for all arenas to finish. Arena promotion/demotion, shared ranks and website skins require the server plugins. Dynamic Halloween features also require Rekting.Arenas; the map download does not install plugins. Rekting branding throughout the church. Website: Skins: Credits Church Pew Bench by tori.cane, CC BY 4.0: . Adapted with opaque back, oak material and adjusted collision. Other asset credits and source conditions are included in CREDITOS.txt and DIREITOS_E_UTILIZACAO.txt. The Tripo witch was supplied by the project owner and retains its original source conditions. Gothic entrance - revision 0492 A new monumental entrance with a medieval stone facade, two hooded statues, pale animated hands with black nails, full-height stone doors sliding sideways, a continuous threshold, and a black surround. Photographic 8K stone textures are used on the doors and steps. On the Rekting Arena server, each connection starts one automatic approach with the camera facing the portal. The fingers writhe, grip and reach, then the hands withdraw into the central seam before the doors open. The player crosses the darkness and is placed in the existing arena waiting system. A private horror soundtrack follows the sequence. This is real-time CS2 geometry and animation, controlled by Rekting.Arenas 0.4.7.9; downloading the map does not install the server plugin. The existing five church arenas are preserved. Entrance credits Medieval Fortress Kit - Aya Rady, CC BY 4.0. Adapted composition and scale. Hooded Figure Statue - llussun7, CC BY 4.0. Converted and scaled for CS2. The Creation of Adam - Loic Norgeot, CC BY 4.0, based on Hand by Artec 3D and Low Poly Human Hands by Jeremy E. Grayson (CC BY). New rig, gestures, mirrored copies, pale materials and black nails. CC BY 4.0: Rock Boulder Cracked - Dimitrios Savva / Dario Barresi; Rock Face 02 - Dario Barresi / Rico Cilliers. Poly Haven, CC0. Neutral stone material conversion. Music: SOUND AIRYLUVS by ISAo - Eternal Terror / Dark Horror Ambient Piano Choir, OGA-BY 3.0. Edited excerpt, equalisation and mix. Ambient horror - techiew, CC0. Stone Door - bonebrah, CC0. Edited excerpts, filtering, timing and mix. Full original and entrance credits are included in CREDITOS.txt and resource/rekting_entrance_credits.txt. Third-party licences remain applicable to their respective assets. Central altar decoration - 25 October 2026 Six pumpkins per central altar, three on each side, with matching lower candles and two new candles on each side. Updated in all five arenas. Full geometry, physics, visibility, navigation, lighting and reflection compilation. Existing entrance, structural collisions and the side altar, floor, shelf and lantern decorations are preserved.
